species.real: Blue iguanas spend much of the year a fairly ordinary grey, and only turn their brightest blue in the breeding season, when the males have someone to impress.
species.name: Azurana

dex.text: Blue as a swimming pool and twice as sunbathed. It sits on a warm rock all day, doing what it calls guarding and what everyone else calls napping.
dex.fact: The Grand Cayman blue iguana fell to about 25 wild animals in the early 2000s; the Blue Iguana Recovery Programme has since brought the wild population back to over a thousand.
